title: TRYING ON OUTFITS KEEPS THE PREVIEWS
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-08, in v19.13 with v19.09 and v19.17: the piece previews are painted with the outfit off and the outfit previews never depended on it, but the worn outfit was part of the look the caches are kept for, so every outfit click in FASHION threw away all 57 pictures and repainted them unchanged. The worn outfit is left out of that look now.
now: Clicking through outfits in FASHION no longer repaints every picture.
